direction: Wide still of the court in session. The usher stands by the door in a dark uniform coat. A man sits in the dock, seen only from behind in a corduroy jacket. His face is never shown. John walks forward from the public seats, a small figure in mid-frame. Slow lateral drift along the benches. Ambience: an usher's call, muffled and unintelligible, boots on boards. About 18 seconds.
